What it does: Electronic health record: clinical notes, orders, results, medication lists, and problem lists for the hospital and all 10 clinics. Includes order entry and clinical decision support (alerts).
Website and app where patients see test results, message their care team, request refills, and schedule clinic visits.
Who relies on it: Patients and family members with proxy access; clinic staff answer messages

What it does: Stores and displays X-rays, CT, MRI, and ultrasound images; radiologists read images and send reports to the EHR.
Receives lab orders from the EHR, tracks specimens, connects to lab analyzers, and sends results back to the EHR.
Pharmacists verify medication orders; connects to automated dispensing cabinets on each unit.
Patient registration, insurance checks, coding, claims to insurers, payments, and patient statements.

System: ERP: finance, HR, payroll, supply chain
What it does: General ledger, budgeting, payroll, staff scheduling, purchasing, and supply inventory.
Video visits for the 10 clinics, mostly follow-ups and behavioral health.
Crews document care on tablets in the ambulance and send the record to the ED on arrival.
Pulls data from the other systems into dashboards on quality, finances, volumes, and staffing.
